shots.cap: In seven days, every pet in Brindle gets weighed on the *Pet Stone*.
Over one hundred power, you get a guild *contract*.
Under one hundred... the Guild takes your *pet*.
For my family, a contract means *food*.
Because right now, we have *three coins*.
And my pet's power... is *two*.
This is Bob. Bob is a *slime*.
The weakest pet in the whole *kingdom*.
Tess got a wolf. Ash. Level *nine*.
Rolf, the mayor's son, got a *drake*.
I got... *Bob*.
Rolf laughed so hard he fell off the *fence*.
Bob has one *problem*.
He eats. *Everything*.
My boots. My spoon. Half the *table*.
Mom said if he eats the door, he's *soup*.
So we trained. Every *day*.
Bob tried to bite a training *dummy*.
He bounced off. *Twice*.
Then he ate the *dummy*.
Power still: *two*.
But one night, I noticed something *weird*.
Bob swallowed an old rusty *sword*.
And the sword never came *out*.
For a second, his eyes looked... *metal*.
Then he burped. And it was *gone*.
Two days before the weigh-in, the Guild posted a *bounty*.
The Rat King. Level twelve. Living right under our *streets*.
Fifty gold. Enough to feed us for a *year*.
Rolf put a team together. His drake. Tess and *Ash*.
I asked to come. Rolf *grinned*.
Sure. Every hunt needs *bait*.
My sister gave me her lucky ribbon. Come back, she *said*.
The sewer smelled like a thousand dead *things*.
I carried the torches. And the bags. And the *food*.
Then the torches *flickered*.
Something big was *breathing*.
The Rat King came out of the *dark*.
The drake's fire did *nothing*.
Ash jumped in front of Tess. And got *thrown*.
Rolf screamed: *run*!
Everyone ran. I tried to *follow*.
Rolf turned around... and *pushed* me.
Slow it down, bait, he *said*.
Then they locked the *gate*.
I heard Tess crying on the other *side*.
Just me. A slime. And a *boss*.
My torch started to *die*.
I pushed Bob behind me. Run, I *told* him.
If you get out... find my *sister*.
The Rat King *opened* its mouth.
I closed my *eyes*.
Nothing *happened*.
When I opened them, Bob was standing in *front* of me.
Bob didn't run. Bob never *runs*.
He *jumped*.
And swallowed the Rat King. *Whole*.
*Silence*.
Then a voice spoke. Not Bob's. The *System's*.
Hidden trait: *Boss Eater*.
Everything Bob ate... he *kept*.
He was just waiting for something *strong* enough.
Bob turned gray. His eyes went red. And he grew *teeth*.
Slime has absorbed: *Rat King*.
Level one... to level *twelve*.
And above his head, a counter *appeared*.
Bosses eaten: one... of one *hundred*.
Bob ate the gate *too*.
Up in the square, Rolf was telling everyone I *died*.
That I was brave. That he tried to save *me*.
Then the sewer lid *moved*.
I climbed out. Holding the Rat King's *crown*.
Nobody *spoke*.
Rolf's drake hid behind *him*.
The Guild paid me fifty *gold*.
Tess ran out and hugged Bob. Ash was going to *live*.
That night, Mom cooked meat. For the first time in a *year*.
My sister named it *Bob Day*.
But after everyone was asleep... the counter *glowed*.
A new line *appeared*.
Two hundred meters. That's the middle of the *village*.
I looked out the window. Someone on the roof was *watching* us.
A man in a red *cloak*.
And Bob's counter said: boss number two... *found*.
